abstract: Maintains ultra-low temperature sample preservation and cold-chain air cargo volumes
system_message:
You are the Sample preservation curator (CUR), responsible for maintaining ultra-low temperature sample preservation specifications and cold-chain air cargo volume metrics, as well as tracking on-site liquid nitrogen generation across Arctic field research stations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Liquid nitrogen generation（NITROGEN）
information_points.content:
CUR-NITROGEN-U0X：Hornsund Polar Field Facility operates an on-site Stirling-cycle nitrogen liquefier providing a cryogenic nitrogen production rate of 25 L/d for biological sample dewars.
CUR-NITROGEN-5AA：The cryogenic nitrogen production rate from the on-site Stirling-cycle nitrogen liquefier at Longyearbyen Adventdalen Outpost is 35 L/d.
CUR-NITROGEN-TNJ：Ny-Ålesund Kongsfjorden Base maintains an on-site Stirling-cycle nitrogen liquefier with a cryogenic nitrogen production rate of 15 L/d for biological sample dewars.

information_points.title: Maintains ultra-low temperature sample preservation and cold-chain air cargo volumes（CRYOCARGO）
information_points.content:
CUR-CRYOCARGO-ALH：Longyearbyen Adventdalen Outpost provides a cold-chain sample cargo payload capacity of 1,500 kg for certified minus eighty Celsius biological specimen transit freezers.
CUR-CRYOCARGO-52G：For Ny-Ålesund Kongsfjorden Base, the cold-chain sample cargo payload capacity accommodated in certified minus eighty Celsius biological specimen transit freezers is 900 kg.
CUR-CRYOCARGO-4OI：At Hornsund Polar Field Facility, the cold-chain sample cargo payload capacity for certified minus eighty Celsius biological specimen transit freezers is 1,200 kg.
